subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful after-compaction hooks become a supported public plugin surface for requesting deferred rotation of their current session?
rationale: The implementation can be mechanically hardened, but deciding whether third-party hooks should gain this session-state capability and what compatibility guarantees it carries requires product and plugin-API ownership.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow hook contract
options.body: Approve the capability only as an after-compaction-specific API with public documentation, surface tests, and complete lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Keep reset operator-owned
options.body: Decline the plugin API and retain session rotation through explicit user or Gateway-owned reset workflows.

options.title: Limit it to an internal seam
options.body: Keep the deferred queue internal to bundled lifecycle policy without exposing it through the public plugin hook context.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow hook contract
recommendation.body: Approve the capability only as an after-compaction-specific API with public documentation, surface tests, and complete lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects this owner candidate to both compaction controls and plugin hook contracts.
